what: Dev-only sweep that chooses the dacl10k v2b ONNX segmenter's look profile (drishyam.agent.PROFILES). Never a held-out set. The rule, the grid and the segmenter were committed in ad0c217, before any v2b sweep row was run, and are unchanged; the rows, the decision and the head check were added after. The comparison of v2b at its profile with v2a, v1 and the classical engine is results/dev/model_choice_dev.json.
costs: fixed: job_ops p50 ms per call from results/local-macos-x86-dacl10k_v2b/micro.json (v2b timed on this Mac, 1 cv2 thread, load 10.64 at start, 14.52 at end); the baselines are charged the same table; governor overrides off (harness.run_drishyam)

variants.ref: min_view 0.3, absorb off: v1's profile values (onnx:drishyam_dacl10k.onnx), the reference, listed first
variants.mv0: min_view 0, absorb off: any level (L0 the finest everywhere)
variants.mv15: min_view 0.15, absorb off: L1 the finest on the 3648- to 6000-px photos, L0 on the 2048- to 2856-px ones
variants.mv25: min_view 0.25, absorb off: v1's runner-up (L2 the finest on 3648- to 6000-px photos, L0 on 2048-px ones)
variants.old: min_view 0, absorb on: the classical-v1 values (the agent before profiles)

rule: Stated before any v2b sweep row was run, and the same as v2a's. Reference: ref (v1's values), listed first in every run, so every candidate is paired with it on the same images and the same cost table. A candidate replaces it only if, at the 30 % cap, (1) its recall is higher than ref's on synth_dev AND on CODEBRIM dev100, each counted only when the paired 95 % bootstrap CI of its recall ratio to ref (vs_ref_ci) lies wholly above 1; and (2) it has no more false alarms on the clean split at the 30 % cap, a harm counted by the same standard: the paired 95 % CI of its boxes-per-photo difference to ref lies wholly above 0, or the CI of the difference in the share of photos with any box (images_with_any_vs_ref_ci) lies wholly above 0. A CI that touches or crosses no change counts as no change, for a gain and for a harm alike. If several candidates pass, the one whose lower vs_ref_ci bound, taken as the smaller of the two splits, is higher. If none passes, v2b gets v1's values (min_view 0.3, absorb off). Everything else (the 1.0 cap, IoU-only recall, boxes on the recall splits, critical boxes, the ratios to L0 tiling and the downscale) is reported, not part of the rule.
command: python -m evals.dev_sweep <clean|synth_dev|real> 0.3,1.0 "<variants>" --workers 6 --baselines --micro-arm local-macos-x86-dacl10k_v2b --codebrim <the main checkout's data/codebrim, read-only> --out <f> --dump <f>, with DRISHYAM_ONNX=models/drishyam_dacl10k_v2b.onnx and DRISHYAM_ONNX_FP16 beside it and PYTHONPATH the worktree (runs/v2b/sweep.sh: the code commit and the load at the start and the end of each run in its log); the head check runs the same command with the variant "head=" (no knob: the profile by name) and without --baselines
decision: no candidate passed the rule: onnx:drishyam_dacl10k_v2b.onnx gets min_view 0.3, absorb False (v1's values)

decision_by_candidate.mv0: synth_dev x1.000 ref (CI 0.97-1.03), CODEBRIM x0.664 (CI 0.56-0.77) at 70.0 boxes per photo against 41.3; clean 1.000 boxes per photo against 1.267 (difference CI -0.93 to 0.33), photos with any box 0.167 against 0.433 (difference CI -0.43 to -0.10); fails; counted changes: loss_real, clean_fewer
decision_by_candidate.mv15: synth_dev x1.000 ref (CI 0.97-1.03), CODEBRIM x0.975 (CI 0.90-1.06) at 97.2 boxes per photo against 41.3; clean 1.000 boxes per photo against 1.267 (difference CI -0.93 to 0.33), photos with any box 0.167 against 0.433 (difference CI -0.43 to -0.10); fails; counted changes: clean_fewer
decision_by_candidate.mv25: synth_dev x1.000 ref (CI 0.97-1.03), CODEBRIM x0.995 (CI 0.98-1.00) at 43.6 boxes per photo against 41.3; clean 1.000 boxes per photo against 1.267 (difference CI -0.93 to 0.33), photos with any box 0.167 against 0.433 (difference CI -0.43 to -0.10); fails; counted changes: clean_fewer

chosen.meaning: onnx:drishyam_dacl10k_v2b.onnx resolves to these values only with the weights above (agent.WEIGHTS); the same file name with other weights gets classical-v1. min_view 0.3 makes L2 the finest level on CODEBRIM's 3648- to 6000-px photos and L1 on 2048-px ones (synth_dev, clean)

notes: grid rows set min_view and absorb explicitly, so their jobs record profile classical-v1 (the name had no PROFILES entry when they ran, and PROFILES holds no other knob); head rows record the model's own profile (head_check.<split@cap>.profiles, from each job)

mv0, mv15 and mv25 are one policy on the 2048-px synth_dev and clean photos (L0 the finest for all three: L0 of a 2048-px photo spans 0.25 of its side), so their rows there match except chance_recall, whose random boxes are seeded by the row name

every _ci: paired 95 % bootstrap intervals over images (1000 resamples, seed 0, evals.harness.boot_ci) against ref within the run (vs_ref_ci); the image ids of every run are asserted equal, and every run's dataset sha256 equals results/dev/onnx_profile_sweep.json's

the rule is applied symmetrically: a gain (vs_ref_ci wholly above 1), a loss (wholly below 1) and a clean harm (difference CI wholly above 0) each count only when the CI excludes no change; verdict lists all of them
clean false alarms: on the clean split every box is a false alarm; the rule reads the boxes-per-photo difference (defined when ref has no box, unlike a ratio) and the share of photos with any box

machine load: files.<run>.load (the 1-min load at the run's start and end, and its min / median / max over one sample a minute, and the other processes that were among the three busiest, with their peak CPU %: a virtual machine and browsers ran beside this work for part of it); this work ran at most 6 worker processes. The fixed cost table makes the rows independent of the load; only the micro timings depend on it (latency: v2b's table was timed at a higher load than v2a's, and v2a re-timed in v2b's window costs about what v2b does)

jobs_at_20s: jobs whose modelled time reached JobConfig.seconds_cap (20 s); longest_job_s: the longest modelled job of each row. On CODEBRIM, mv0, mv15 and old reached it on most jobs at both caps (v2b's table was timed at a 1-min load of 10.6 to 14.5, v2a's at 7.9, and the v2a grid's mv0 and old reached it on 11 jobs at the 1.0 cap only), so their CODEBRIM rows partly measure that cap. The decision does not rest on them: the rule needs a measurable synth_dev gain, no candidate had one, and no synth_dev job reached the cap

boxes are per-component boxes (the harness's primary convention for every policy); critical counts boxes of a critical class and size (findings.is_critical), the ones the human gate would hold; per_image.ms is the modelled ms per job (the fixed table's virtual clock)
